title: Badminton Roguelike Mobile Game by Opus 5.5
author: SoftFine859
selftext: My last post got a lot of attention, but I actually didn't think that a lot of people want to play that, I thought its just a niche game that's good for my leisure time and I was just expressing my amazement towards current ai development, currently I only have the apk file, as I am a student, I dont have much experience in platforms like itch io and I know nothing about ios, if this post reaches 500 upvotes, I will plan on investing my time to learn how to distribute the game, and I'm open to any kind hearted guides in the comments
